brief: A visible sprite character and a patrol enemy sprite populate a horizontal level built upon segments of ground. The player controls the character using keyboard or mouse input to move and jump between platforms. The character must maneuver and jump over, or around, the patrolling enemy sprite to continue the action. The scene continuously updates and animates the movement of both the character and the hostile enemy along the defined path.

statement: This sketch presents a simple platformer scene with a player character and a patrolling enemy. The player can move left or right using arrow keys and jump with the spacebar. The enemy moves back and forth along a horizontal path, creating a dynamic challenge. The animation runs continuously without user input, showing both characters in motion, and responds visibly to a single click by changing the scene state.
